# Week of Data

> One week, one location for a week of data community events. Week of Data is a community movement: once the calendar reaches 100 subscribers, the community collectively decides on the first week and location for the inaugural Week of Data.

## Links

- Calendar: https://luma.com/weekofdata?k=c
- Organizer: Alex Merced (https://alexmerced.com)
- Community hub: https://datalakehousehub.com
- Contact: WeekOfData@DataLakehouseHub.com

## How to Participate

Subscribe to the calendar on Luma. Once the week is determined, you can have your data event added to the official calendar by emailing WeekOfData@DataLakehouseHub.com.
